reader_question: How many governments of each kind does the country have?
grade_line: Documented: the Census Bureau’s 2022 Census of Governments
title: Special districts were the most common kind of government in the country in 2022, 39,555 of the 90,888 the Census Bureau counted.
measure_line: Governments by type, 2022, United States; each circle’s area is in proportion to its count
notes: The Census Bureau counts a school system run by a state, county, city or township as part of that government, so the 12,546 independent school districts leave those systems out.
chart_notes: The circle the title names, special districts, takes the text’s ink, with its count inside; the others are gray with a thin edge, named beside. The federal government and the 50 states print in words, since at this scale the federal government’s circle would be under a pixel across and the states’ a few pixels.
alt: Circles sized by area for five kinds of local government in 2022: special districts, 39,555, the largest; municipalities, 19,491; townships, 16,214; independent school districts, 12,546; and counties, 3,031. One federal government and 50 state governments print in words.

columns.label: Government, as the Census Bureau names it

labels.words: Not drawn: {list}, too few to draw at this scale.

notes_internal: Maker A, round 4. Data plan row 116, rule 14.80. Domain D04 (V7 I165). Source line: the sidecar's printed line.

Data lead rulings (a) subject ink on special districts, the title's named kind, no red (an area, round 3 principle 3); (b) five circles at true area on one scale, the others in the track ink with a 1 px context-ink edge (RF-1, MA-4), a key of three nested circles at 1,000, 10,000 and 40,000 in the context ink (MA-5), the federal government and the states in words over the circles with a hairline under them; (c) the grade line. MA-6: 'were' for a 2022 count.

Checks by script (maker_a_round4_derive.py --figures, check S86): 39,555 the largest local kind, 43.5 percent of the 90,837 local governments and no majority; 90,888 the U.S. total with the federal government and 50 states; every count in the alt equals the file; the county circle at least 12 px across at 256 px.
